capabilities: Export a folder of notes to one PDF
Order notes by the folder's index note links, with drag reordering and a checklist
Add a PDF outline and a contents page with page numbers
Make cross-references between exported notes clickable
Append linked notes from outside the folder
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or newer. The PDF is written to a location you choose; the plugin only reads notes and never writes into the vault, and makes no network requests. Beta builds can be installed with BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no way to combine a folder of notes into one ordered PDF document with a contents page and working links between the notes.

relations.evidence: Optional: the Native TikZ plugin 1.2.0 or newer, so TikZ diagrams print in the light theme.

summary: Exports all notes in a folder into a single PDF with an outline, contents page and clickable cross-references.
